question: Which of the following statements is FALSE with respect to multiple myeloma?

options.opa: The cytogenetics and serum levels of albumin and beta2-microglobulin are important data for the prognosis.
options.opb: Bortezomib, thalidomide, lenalidomide and polychemotherapy are very useful therapeutic tools.
options.opc: Autogenic transplantation of hematopoietic progenitors provides a long progression-free survival.
options.opd: Allogeneic transplantation should be considered an experimental procedure (of unproven efficacy).
options.ope: Radiation therapy has no role in the treatment of the disease or its complications.
